api.unexpected: An unexpected server error occurred. Contact the system administrator.
api.concurrentUpdate: Another user has updated this record. Reload it before saving.
api.databaseUpdateFailed: The database update failed. Contact the system administrator.
api.foreignKey: Other records reference this data. Remove those records or their links before continuing.
api.validationFailed: The input is invalid. Check the field values.
api.network: Cannot connect to the backend API. Check that the service is running at {baseUrl}, then refresh this page.
api.unauthorized: Unauthorized (401). If sign-in is enabled, sign in to obtain a Token.
api.conflict: Other records reference this data. Remove the related child records or their links before continuing.
api.forbidden: Permission denied (403). Viewers can only view and query data.
api.environmentMismatch: Safety check blocked the request: WEB is {webEnvironment} and API is {apiEnvironment}. Writes are prohibited because the environments differ.
api.ssoExpired: The Portal SSO request has expired.
api.ssoSignature: The Portal SSO signature is invalid.
api.ssoReplayed: The Portal SSO request has already been used.
api.accountAmbiguous: This AD account matches multiple SPC users. Contact an administrator; no new account will be created.
api.employeeAmbiguous: This employee number matches multiple SPC users. Contact an administrator; no new account will be created.
api.identityConflict: The AD account and employee number belong to different SPC users. Contact an administrator; accounts will not be merged or created automatically.
api.employeeBound: This employee number is linked to another AD account. Contact an administrator; no new account will be created.
api.accountDisabled: This SPC operator account is disabled.
api.legacyProvisionDenied: The legacy sign-in exchange cannot create users. Sign in again through the portal with complete account and employee-number information.
api.localLoginDisabled: Local password sign-in is disabled in SPC. Use your AD account or employee number.
api.jwtNotConfigured: Auth:JwtKey is missing or too short (at least 32 characters).
api.viewerWriteDenied: Viewers can only view and query data. They cannot add, edit, delete or import data.
api.ppcScopeGroupMissing: No chart group was found for this business scope.
api.ppcScopeMismatch: The chart group does not match the selected business scope.
api.ppcPartRequired: Select a product part number for the {groupName} control item.
api.ppcMachineRequired: Select a line/machine for the {groupName} control item.
api.ppcTankRequired: Select a tank for the {groupName} control item.
api.ppcTankBeforeSlot: Select a tank before selecting a slot.
api.ppcSlotMismatch: The slot does not belong to the selected tank.
api.ppcFormulaInvalid: The formula configuration format is invalid.
api.ppcChemicalFormulaInvalid: The chemical analysis formula configuration format is invalid.
api.ppcCharacteristicMissing: The specified quality characteristic was not found.
api.ppcProcessMissing: The specified enabled process was not found.
api.ppcTrendGroupMissing: No enabled trend chart group is configured for this business scope.
api.ppcTrendScopeMismatch: The trend chart group does not match the selected business scope.
api.ppcChartTypeRequired: Specify an SPC chart type when displaying a control chart.
api.ppcChartTypeMissing: The specified SPC chart type was not found.
api.ppcChartGroupMissing: No chart group was found for this control type.
api.ppcDataCategoryMismatch: The chart type and quality characteristic data categories do not match.
api.ppcTrendTypeOnly: Trend chart display requires a trend chart type; a control chart cannot also be selected.
api.ppcControlTypeOnly: Control chart display requires a control chart type; a trend chart cannot also be selected.
api.ppcDuplicate: An SPC control item already has the same control type, part number, process, line, tank, slot, inspection characteristic and unit. Edit the existing item or change one identifying field.
api.ppcRulesFixed: All control items use the eight WE rules. Item-specific rules are not supported.
api.ppcHasMeasurements: This control item has measurements or SPC calculation data. Disable it; use permanent purge only for confirmed incorrect or test data.
api.ppcClosedAlert: This control item has closed alerts. To retain quality traceability, it can only be disabled and cannot be permanently purged.
api.ppcReasonTooLong: The reference document/change reason is limited to 500 characters. Shorten the document name or description.
